Unreasonable ads…. I want to preface by saying: I understand a free app might have some ads, but this is excessive. I downloaded this with the hope of using it as a chromatic tuner, since my clip on tuner doesn’t have that option. In the free version, during 1 tuning session, I had to watch through 2 ads (one when I opened the app, and another after I tuned maybe 2 strings). Then there’s the flashing ads right in the middle of the screen that are conveniently located right where you might accidentally tap them. My tune never sounded quite perfect, so I clipped on my regular tuner and realized that E was almost a half step flat, and D was sharp. So not only is it frustrating to use, but it can’t even be accurate?? I’m not sure how this app ended up with such great reviews, maybe the older versions were better. But the 2026 version is horrific, and I used it 1 time before deleting.

reviews.text: Love it💙. Excellent tuner

There are tuners and then there are tuners. It’s interesting even in an app simulation of analogue tuning how close based on criteria presented can make even harmonics level.. I sweeten my tuning and the scale based meter makes for tuning James Taylor sweet easy. This is a fantastic app. If you are looking for tuning down to the cent… it will serve you well. If simple 440 is all you are looking for there are many that will accommodate that but why not just use one that can count 100cents right off? In the end an app like this is where you will land anyway. 

That said it’s a simple app.. and can (although it’s very close) replace an analogue harmonic rotary tuner in my opinion. But then again who has the money for a big expense of that… the math is sound. And so is this tuner.
